text:
Anya Patel: Heads up — planning to move from Oakland, CA -> London, UK July 15. Can someone confirm what I need to do for payroll, benefits, and the WFH stipend? Also worried about any tax nexus implications for the company if I go full-time remote from the UK.

Jess Ortega: Congrats on the move! :tada: Quick checklist from People Ops: 1) Update your home address in Workday, 2) complete the "International Remote Request" form, 3) we need your anticipated move date + new local address for benefits enrollment. We can advise on stipend proration once we know dates.

Anya Patel: Thanks — will update Workday today. Do I need to wait for manager approval before we process anything?

Rami Kaur: No need to block — I already gave verbal OK. Please attach my approval in the form and cc me on the relocation email. I just want to confirm this won't affect your current sprint cadence.

Mike Chen: Payroll note: moving to the UK may require a payroll change (local payroll or contractor conversion) depending on employment type and duration. If you're staying >6 months we typically trigger a payroll review with our external UK payroll partner. Can you confirm if you'll keep US bank account or need GBP pay?

Anya Patel: I'll still have my US bank account for now but would prefer to switch to GBP after settling there. Hope to be there >6 months but finalizing dates.

Ben Ortiz: Benefits heads-up: US domestic medical plans often don't provide coverage overseas except for emergencies. If you're moving long-term we need to explore either a local plan or expat coverage. Please send your expected move window and we will run options. Dental/vision usually handled separately.

Jess Ortega: WFH stipend: policy is pro-rated by calendar month when location changes. Example: move on July 15 -> July stipend = 50% (if stipend is monthly). We'll calculate exact prorate for your July/Aug transition. Also, relocation assistance is discretionary; submit the relocation request form and include any receipts for reimbursable items.

Mike Chen: Tax nexus concern: thanks for flagging. Short answer: your move alone doesn't automatically create a company tax nexus in the UK, but having a UK-based employee can create obligations (employer payroll taxes, filings). We'll escalate to Legal and Tax. Please do not start client meetings in UK timezone that could imply a UK presence until Tax signs off.

Payroll Bot: Reminder — please complete the International Remote Request: https://redwood.internal/forms/international-remote (deadline: 7 days before move).

Anya Patel: Got it. One more: will Redwood support visa sponsorship if I need it?

Jess Ortega: Visa sponsorship is case-by-case. People Ops + Legal evaluate based on role, length of stay, and local requirements. Add your visa questions to the form and we'll loop in Legal.

Rami Kaur: I'm happy to support sponsorship if needed. Please ping me once you know more.

Mike Chen: Action items for Anya: update Workday address, complete the intl remote form, confirm anticipated length of stay, decide on bank currency preference. People Ops/Payroll/Benefits/Legal will coordinate after form submitted.

Anya Patel: Thank you all — I'll fill out the form today and attach my tentative lease. Appreciate the guidance! :heart:
